history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration create and approve service entry sheet promptly upon the delivery of service and, especially at year end, have the service entry sheet be approved within the deadline so that the relevant expense is posted in the correct year.
history.administration_response: The Administration continues to emphasize the importance of approving service entry sheet or goods receipts promptly upon the delivery of the service and within the deadline through year-end meetings with heads of offices. Offices are required to confirm, and have confirmed, the validity and accuracy of outstanding commitments. Service entry sheets and goods receipts that are not posted in time are captured by the accrual of expenses from outstanding commitments whose services and goods are delivered by the end of the year. Hence, expenses for the services delivered are fully recorded or accrued.
history.board_assessment: Given that the supporting document for the accrual of expenses was not provided, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
